turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
What happened next?
I am cold all the time, I wear two jumpers inside the flat.
And how was that for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. That is how it was.
Tell me more about that.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
And how was that for you?
I keep imagining my father's face if he found out, I think he would be disappointed.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. I keep coming back to it.
Take your time.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
Tell me more about that.
At the service I met a nurse called Bridget and she asked me to keep a food diary.
Tell me more about that.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. That is how it was.
What went through your mind then?
I had a panic attack in the exam hall, but I stayed and finished the paper.
Take your time.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. That is how it was.
Mm-hm. Go on.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
Thank you, see you next week.
